g.text: RETAILIQ: AI-POWERED E-COMMERCE DECISION INTELLIGENCE SUITE
HIGH-LEVEL DESIGN (HLD) SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & END-TO-END DATA FLOW | MID-TERM EVALUATION
1. ENTERPRISE STAKEHOLDER PERSONAS & ROLE-BASED ACCESS CONTROL (RBAC)
Cryptographic Persona Gating | Salted SHA-256 Storage | Dynamic Viewport Routing
Full platform governance, dynamic RBAC user configuration, pipeline re-triggering,
Complete Access: 9 Core System Modules Unlocked
Predictive model performance validation (ROC-AUC, Precision), transaction anomaly isolation,
Analytical Access: 7 Data & Machine Learning Modules Unlocked
High-level financial KPIs ($1.84M GMV), 14-day sales forecasting, interactive What-If simulator,
Executive Access: 6 Managerial & Prescriptive Decision Modules
Customer 360 profile inspector, real-time NLP sentiment feedback mining, retention incentives,
Targeted Access: 1,193 Customer Profiles & Automated Winback Offers
AUTHENTICATED CLIENT COMMUNICATION & ROLE-GATED NAVIGATION (HTTPS / STREAMLIT REACTIVE PROTOCOL) ▼
Streamlit Framework | Reactive Zero-Reload st.tabs Navigation | Plotly 5.18.0 Visualizers | Parameter Sliders
Visuals: Plotly Metric Cards & Donut Charts
Visuals: ROC Curve, PR Curve, Gini Ranking
• Strategic Sliders: SLA Boost, Promo, VIP Reach
• Financial Output: Saved Accounts & Recovered ARR
Visuals: Reactive Gauge & ROI Simulator Cards
CORE APPLICATION SUBSYSTEM PIPELINES (AUTONOMOUS ANALYTICAL & INFERENCE ENGINES) ▼
• Ingests disparate raw schemas (Kaggle, Multi-Channel CSVs)
• Maps aliases: CustomerID → Customer_ID, CouponUsed → Coupons
• Median Imputation: Fills quantitative nulls via column medians
• Mode Imputation: Fills categorical fields via frequent classes
• Outlier Boundary Isolation: IQR clipping on monetary amounts
Zero unhandled missing values, zero redundant keys, ready for ML training.
• Computes GMV, Profit, Margin %, AOV, Order Frequency
• Multi-dimensional grouping by Department, Device, City
• Recency (R): Days elapsed since most recent transaction
• Champions: Low Recency, High Freq, High Spend (VIP Perks)
• Loyal Accounts: Consistent repeat buyers (Cross-sell / Upsell)
• At-Risk Accounts: High lifetime spend, delayed recency (Winback)
Detects negative profit transactions and rogue discount stacking (>50%).
• Architecture: 50 Decision Trees, Gini Impurity Criterion
• Training Cohort: 5,630 Kaggle Records (80/20 Stratified Split)
Recall: 64.85% | F1-Score: 0.7507 | Resists Class Imbalance (16.8% Churn)
• Simulates managerial interventions and calculates financial return:
Sim_Churn = max(4.0, Base_Churn - Δ_S - Δ_V - Δ_P)
• Recovered ARR = Saved Accounts * Average Order Value
• Flags support bottlenecks, shipping delays, & margin leakage
• Emotion Classifiers: Maps keywords to Joy, Anger, Frustration
Profile-Driven Recommendations: 25% VIP winback for At-Risk
ENTERPRISE PERSISTENCE, CRYPTOGRAPHIC AUTHENTICATION & STORAGE LAYER ▼
4. ENTERPRISE DATA PERSISTENCE & PHYSICAL REPOSITORY LAYER
Relational SQLite DB | Raw & Cleansed Data Corpora | Serialized Machine Learning Model Storage
Security Guarantee: Zero plaintext password exposure
• 1,408 Unseen Test Cohort in Separate File
Ground-Truth Integrity: Verified real-world enterprise dataset
• Festive Surge | Support Friction | Margin Leakage
Comprehensive Scope: Full transactional & review coverage
• Sub-40ms real-time inference latency across sessions
Production-Grade Serving: Instantaneous scoring on demand
